items.note: The scratch-cancelling schedule, net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, and the three-stage map (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) all follow the proof at 741-765. The plan never gives h=100, the triple indexing of the banks, the neighbour rules (|S∩T|=1, or even intersection) or the wire counts.

Gives the common frame per gate, its commutation with pointwise gates, D_out S D_in^{-1} and the fact that only the endpoint frames matter, as at 804-825. It is a single infer step with no sub-steps, so it counts as stated, not derived.

Correct: the form (I-J/9) with pairings |S∩T|-1 and 2, the interstage labels, the side-wire chain, the central 3->4 loss h, the telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The edge-by-edge residual table (1021-1043), which checks comparability on the data-wire edges, is not reproduced. Neither is the F_2 orthonormal-basis part. I chose partial, the conservative verdict.

These steps follow the proof at 1156-1172: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s=Wm-N+2L with deficit N-2L>0, and the endpoint P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m giving the shear on every role.

S2.1 gives the phase frames C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m. It claims C^{⊗m} on every role without the source and sink Z corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange; S2.3 only partly restores these. The weight-additivity derivation (1231-1260) is absent.

L/N<1/2 gives the deficit N-2L>0 (bit), and S1.3.6 follows 1331-1343: a deficit above 20·2^{-50} together with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}). The exact deficits η_b and η_c are never given, log m<20 is left implicit, and S1.3.6 states only the bit ratio, not s_c/W_c<m^σ.
S1.1 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S1.2 leaves out the hypothesis that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time; the quote contains it, but the claim does not.

The shear derivation is faithful: triangular parts in descending order, and each one of Pi done as D_j+=H_i, interchange, D_j=H_i-D_j (1425-1446). The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 is only asserted; its elimination proof (1375-1392) and the choice of the prime are missing.

Follows the paper's proof: the cyclic row split into W role streams, edge shears by recursive interchanges, Φ_{I_m} on every row, three shears making an interchange, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum cases, and the depth-first parking schedule.
Follows the paper: the high-digit row field R=q^{2ρ}>=W^k, row padding, base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^τ), O(V log(2e)) for the remaining moves, radix-q padding, and the one-bit-difference case.

Correct: the slot implementation, the inverse-child identity, exactly s_c child calls on e/m axes, H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, and basis changes as row additions. The reason it works is missing: the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv}, with the residual basis as the first columns of M (1849-1865).
Follows the proof: eight parity operations composing to (00 10)(01 11), the guard interval, the union bound δ_bad, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, radix-sort repair, and the full time bound.
Follows the paper: rows from the first q_0 chunks, the u=Wg+w split, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1), the overhead O(e^λ), the leaf term e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{λ'}).

Gives the O(Vd^{λ'}) layer, one final truncation with error <√2·2^{-p}, and the guard-width argument (A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, 8B^2 d^{ν+1}, C_0 d^{C_1} with C_1=20, p+Δ fractional bits, εC_1<1), as in the paper.

Follows the paper: character cancellation via y^{rj_0}=-1, the decimation-in-frequency formula, bit-reversed storage, the reversed recursion giving F^+B^{-1}, the layout L and its costs, truncation commuting with J_E, error √2·ℓ·2^{-p}, and the operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}.
Follows the paper's proof: the separation bound, block-wise signed evaluation, centered extraction with carry in {0,1}, the negacyclic wrap with |H_j|<=r·2^{2p}, and the shift by p+ℓ.
Gives the normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LB·P(u,v), the error chain 2δ+η, then 3δ+η, then scaling by M, and the cost, matching 3414-3495.

Follows the paper: TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, the Neumann inverse of N=CTD, A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with normalization 2^{-2α^2}, errors 16p, 3p^2/4 and 4, sorts not executed, the tensor identity, linewise application, and axis exposure. The explicit index maps of P_s and P_t are not written out.

The cancellation of R is derived faithfully (dilation identity, commutation with pointwise products, normalized convolution rule). The chirp identity (S6) is stated, but the coefficient computation and the periodicity check (3939-3951) are not shown.
Gives all fixed exponents, the sizes, α, γ, η, the prime intervals via the Rosser-Schoenfeld bound, T/2<S<T, α^4θ_i>p and the n^{o(1)} search, as in the paper.
Gives the isomorphism argument, the triangular formula, the update order i=d..1 with padded rotations, and the O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)) cost, as in the paper.
Gives the wrap check ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, M_C=D_-ι^{-1}M_r(ιD_+f,ιD_+g)=(f*g)/T, and the computed twists, matching the paper.
Gives the source transform composition, its exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite transform, and the six steps with the two roles of S, as in 4454-4544.
Follows the paper's error chain: E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9·2^γ·TL, 3E_s+2, E_w<28·2^γ·T^2·L, final error <448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, then rounding and carries.
Gives the cost rows, the seven margins with min=2^{-181}=2κ, setup and exceptional sorting as o(V), log-power absorption, and the schoolbook cutoff, as in the paper.
S0 says the bound disproves the n log n optimality conjecture in this model. It never says what an eventual lower bound would require or why the liminf/limit is zero.

errors.says: Method: pick triple lines whose pairings are intersection sizes.
errors.paper: For the bit (rational) labels the pairing is <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1 with <t_T,t_T>=2; over F_2 it is the dot product, so |S∩T| mod 2 (lines 856-868). S1.3.3a states this correctly.

errors.says: A target field can be updated by an offset computed from earlier control fields in O(V) time.
errors.paper: The O(V) bound holds if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from the fixed number of control values (line 566).

errors.says: The complex network has endpoint operator C^{⊗m} on every role.
errors.paper: C^{⊗m} holds on every role only after the source and sink diagonal (Z) corrections and undoing the signed bank exchange; without them, the X_a->Y_a route carries C^{-1} on 27 coordinates (lines 1225-1227, 1290-1314).

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}) by the paper's route. It builds the bit network, frames, labels, the rank budget, the endpoint identity, the matrix shear and the recurrence for the interchange; then the phase network, packed basis changes and the layer recurrence for the butterfly layer; then transforms, convolution, resampling, chirp/R-cancellation, the CRT map, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the root of the construction (no h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 or neighbour rules), and in places where it only states results: the complex phase interface (no weight-additivity derivation), the conjugation identity that puts residual directions into coordinate slots, the lower-triangular factorization, and the chirp coefficient computation.

steps.note: The fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire is there. The defining quantities are missing: h=100, banks indexed by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3, and m=h^3 (m appears only as a dimension). I chose the conservative verdict.
There is a common invertible frame per gate, commuting with pointwise gates, so the network implements D_out S_Ω D_in^{-1} and each edge only changes frame.
Labels are nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, nested along every edge. The only decreasing edges are central 3->4, each losing h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U. The N source edges, with 2P_{U_a} of rank one at zero dimension change, are the exceptions.
The sum of |Δdim| is Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the edge ranks total s=Wm-N+2L.
L/N=100/539 (bit) or 101/539 (complex), below 1/2, so N-2L>0 and s<Wm.
Terminal matrices differ by I_m (P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m), so the network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch roles included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2. The shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so a node makes s recursive calls.

Children have volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} because the deficit exceeds 20·2^{-50} and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}); hence F_k=O(e^τ). log m<20 is used only implicitly.

central.summary: Eight of the nine central steps are reconstructed with their defining content: frames, labels, rank equals dimension change, the budget, the strict saving, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. The only gap is the concrete fixed network (C1): the exchange-and-restore behaviour is present, but h=100, the triple indexing, N and m=h^3 are never stated.
